# History Minor
Source: https://academiccatalog.umd.edu/undergraduate/colleges-schools/arts-humanities/history/history-minor/
Source: https://history.umd.edu/academics/undergraduate/history-minor
Source: https://arhu.umd.edu/academics/undergraduate-studies/minors
Fetched: 2026-09-28

## Catalog requirements

Participating students must complete 18 credits (6 courses) in History.
The courses must be distributed in at least 2 geographic fields (Africa and the African Diaspora, Asia, Europe, Latin America and the Caribbean, Middle East, Transregional, United States).
The courses must include at least one course in each of two chronological periods (pre-1750/post-1750).
A minimum of 9 credits (3 courses) must be taken at the 3xx or 4xx-level.
No more than 3 credits (1 course) may be fulfilled by AP, IB, or transfer credit.
A student may use a maximum of 6 credits (2 courses) to satisfy requirements for both a major and a minor. Courses completed for one minor may not be used to satisfy the requirements for another minor.
Any student is eligible to pursue the minor, with the exception of a student majoring in History.

History Minor
The History Minor is an excellent way for students to turn an interest in history into a valuable credential and skill set. In working with both primary and secondary sources, students will hone their skills in research methods, critical thinking and expository/analytical writing. The History Minor pairs well with other disciplines such as government and politics, law, and political science, among countless others.
The History Minor is designed to introduce students to the broad field of historical study, both by deepening their knowledge and understanding of the past and by developing their ability to do critical, historically-minded analysis.
About the History Minor
Requirements
Participating students are required to complete 18 credits (6 courses) in History. The courses must be distributed in at least 2 geographic fields (Asia, Europe, Middle East, United States, etc.) and must include at least one course in each of two chronological periods (pre-1750/post-1750). A minimum of 9 credits are required in courses at the 300- or 400- level. No more than 3 credits (1 course) may be at the 100- level, and no more than 3 credits (1 course) can be fulfilled by AP, IB, or transfer credit.
Please note that the History Major and the History Minor are not interchangeable. The Major allows students to complete more in-depth study of a particular interest, engages students with research seminars, and allows a much greater understanding of the field.

Undergraduate Studies
Minors are an excellent way for students to gain expertise in an area beyond the major. We encourage students to work with their advisors early to incorporate the minor into their Academic Plans.
Applications for all minors remain open until the minor is filled. Students will be taken on a first-come, first-served basis. When you click on the “contact form” below and select the appropriate option on the form, your request will be marked with the date and time. Please keep in mind that any pre-requisites must be completed by the time of application. (Students applying to the Music Performance minor must successfully pass an audition and should contact the advisor through the form below as soon as possible.)
When a minor is listed as CLOSED, it is closed until October 1 in the fall semester or March 1 in the spring semester. You may check this site again at these times. When a minor is listed as WAITLIST, it is closed, but you may put yourself on a waitlist by clicking on "contact form" below and selecting the appropriate option.
